text:
auditor_sam: Quick Q — SOC2 fieldwork next Wed. Can you provide a filtered session export that demonstrates RBAC fallback/rollback cases and any ephemeral KMS key usage tied to those sessions? Auditor needs chain-of-custody for fallback incidents (config-based routing fallback to older model variants). Time window: last 90 days. Also need proof of redaction applied.

maria_sec: Yep. Do you need full raw logs or pre-redacted CSV? Also which selectors for 'fallback' — are you after routing_policy=fallback OR response_code=FALLBACK? @oncall_lee FYI

auditor_sam: Prefer pre-redacted CSV. Selectors: routing_event:"fallback" OR model_variant_change AND (kms_key_usage OR ephemeral_key) within 5m of event. Time window 2025-12-01..2026-02-28. Minimal PII. Also want mapping to RBAC change events (role grants/revokes) within same window.

maria_sec: Got it. We'll produce:
- presigned S3 CSV with redaction
- splunk/export query and sample raw JSON for chain-of-custody
- correlated RBAC change list (cloud IAM + internal service role updates)

I'll run these two queries:

```
# Splunk (inference logs)
index=inference service=inference-rt (routing_event=fallback OR routing_event="model_variant_fallback") earliest=12/01/2025:00:00:00 latest=02/28/2026:23:59:59
| eval session_id=coalesce(session_id, request_id)
| table _time session_id user_id routing_event model_variant target_variant kms_key_id request_path
```

and

```
# Cloud trail / IAM
eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile earliest=12/01/2025 latest=02/28/2026
| fields eventTime userIdentity.principalId requestParameters
```

oncall_lee: Heads up — some fallback routing runs on edge proxies; those logs live in edge-proxy-cluster and have shorter retention (90 days). If you need older samples we'll need archive pulls.

evidence-bot: export job started: export_id=exp-20260301-7, ETA ~35m. Files will land in s3://audits/soc2/4387654321/

maria_sec: @auditor_sam tagging format: we'll include an 'evidence_manifest.csv' with mapping: session_id, event_time, artifact_path, redaction_level, verifier. Anything else?

auditor_sam: Add 'incident_link' column if the session was tied to an incident ticket. Also include checksums for each artifact. Thanks :pray:

infra_joel: For the KMS tie-ins: ephemeral keys are logged in kms-audit. We'll join on kms_key_id but note ephemeral key ids are rotated; include key wrap metadata and envelope ids.

maria_sec: Perfect. I'll share presigned links once the export finishes, and drop a short README with query and redact rules. ETA 2 hours. cc @oncall_lee

auditor_sam: Great, appreciate it :thumbsup:
